and.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM role WHERE name = 'HQ_ADMIN'

changeSet.comment: Ensure HQ admin user exists and is mapped to HQ_ADMIN role by name (no hardcoded role_id).
changeSet.sql:
-- Insert HQ admin user if missing (role_id resolved by role.name) INSERT INTO users ( id, contact_number, created_at, email, employment_type, first_name, is_deleted, is_status_locked, language_code, last_name, password, photo_url, profile_update_request_status, restaurant_id, role_id, status, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, user_code, profile_update_request_data, profile_update_requested_at, profile_update_reviewed_at, app_type, device_token, device_type, photo_thumbnail_url ) SELECT 'f9a963d6-4cc8-4739-bd50-d4c42f5c0811', '9876598765', '2026-01-19 10:01:35.044111'::timestamptz, 'shailesh.parkhi@joshsoftware.com', 'FULL_TIME', 'Shailesh', FALSE, FALSE, 'en', 'Parkhi', '$2a$10$Vm1TAWNB89uz/17j0c6c6u9H/S8qUqjV0d39kGExr/Urm8pYW6aUS', 'https://qr-table-development.s3.ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com/profile-images/employee/admin_images_1768816822656.png', 'NONE', NULL, (SELECT id FROM role WHERE name = 'HQ_ADMIN'), 'ACTIVE', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL, NULL, 'ADMIN01', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = 'shailesh.parkhi@joshsoftware.com' );
-- If the user already exists, ensure role_id matches HQ_ADMIN by name UPDATE users SET role_id = (SELECT id FROM role WHERE name = 'HQ_ADMIN'), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE email = 'shailesh.parkhi@joshsoftware.com' AND ( role_id IS NULL OR role_id != (SELECT id FROM role WHERE name = 'HQ_ADMIN') );
